title: PRISM2 model uses clinical dialogue to interpret pathology slides
summary: PRISM2 is a medical AI model developed by Paige and Microsoft that uses a perceiver-based encoder to analyze whole-slide pathology images, trained jointly on tissue tiles and clinical dialogue from pathology reports. The model aggregates thousands of tile embeddings per slide into a unified representation and generates diagnostic text answers rather than performing simple pixel classification.
problem_solved: Enables AI systems to interpret pathology slides with clinical context by combining visual analysis with natural language dialogue from pathology reports.
why_valuable: It advances digital pathology by moving beyond basic image classification toward contextual diagnostic understanding, potentially improving accuracy and efficiency in cancer diagnosis.
